a.lede: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.
a.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve

b.lede: Apple CEO John Ternus doesn't have a timeline for when iPhone Duo supply constraints could lift. b.title: Apple is ‘not able to predict’ when it’ll have enough iPhone Duos to go around
